arabic text: RO RAHI HAIN SOCHHKAR, RO RAHI HAIN SOCHHKAR, UMMUL BANEEN YE AAJ BHI,\nASGHAR E BESHEER JAISI QABR HA ABBAS KI
english translation text: UMMUL BANEEN CRIES TO THIS DAY, WITH THIS THOUGHT IN MIND, THE\nGRAVE OF ABBAS HOLDS A LIKENESS TO THE GRAVE OF ALI ASGHAR

arabic text: RASHK KARTI THI ME AQS E HAIDER E QARRAR PAR,
english translation text: PAUN KHAT DETE THE USKE BAITH KAR RAHWAR PAR, I USED TO BEAM WITH PRIDE, AT HIM, THE LIKENESS OF HAIDER, AS HE RODE ON HIS HORSE, HIS FEET WOULD TOUCH THE GROUND

arabic text: HAYE MERE SHER KI, YE KAISI HAALAT HOGAYI,\nASGHAR E BESHEER JAISI QABR HA ABBAS KI
english translation text: WOE TO THE CONDITION OF MY LION, HOW DID THIS HAPPEN? THE\nGRAVE OF ABBAS HOLDS A LIKENESS TO THE GRAVE OF ALI ASGHAR

arabic text: BAAP KE BADLE MUSALMAANO NE BETE SE LIYE,\nSAR JUDA HAI TAN JUDA BAZU JUDA HAI SHER KE,
english translation text: THE ‘MUSLIMS’ EXACTED REVENGE ON THE SON, FOR THEIR HATRED OF\nTHE FATHER, MY LION LIES WITH HIS HEAD AND ARMS SEVERED

arabic text: AAPKI TASWEER TUKDE TUKDE, HOGAYI HAI YA ALI\nASGHAR E BESHEER JAISI QABR HA ABBAS KI
english translation text: OH ALI, YOUR LIKENESS IS NOW TORN TO PIECES\nTHE GRAVE OF ABBAS HOLDS A LIKENESS TO THE GRAVE OF ALI ASGHAR

arabic text: SHAAMIYO NE LAASH KO PAAMAL YE KEHKAR KIYA,\nKYA ISI ABBAS PAR BINTE ALI KO NAAZ THA,
english translation text: THE PEOPLE OF SHAAM TRAMPLED HIS BODY WHILE CRYING OUT, IS THIS\nTHE ABBAS THAT THE DAUGHTER OF ALI WAS SO PROUD OF?

arabic text: SAANIYE ZEHRA SAMAA YE, DEKH KAR ROTI HUWI\nASGHAR E BESHEER JAISI QABR HA ABBAS KI
english translation text: ZAINAB CONTINUED TO CRY AT THIS SIGHT\nTHE GRAVE OF ABBAS HOLDS A LIKENESS TO THE GRAVE OF ALI ASGHAR

arabic text: KAB SAMATA THA MERI CHADAR ME TU AAYE MERE LAAL,\nKAR DIYA HAI ZAALIMON NE TE TERE LAASHE KA HAAL,
english translation text: WHEN WAS IT POSSIBLE FOR YOU TO BE DRAPED IN MY SHAWL?\nLOOK WHAT THESE OPPRESSORS HAVE DONE TO YOU, OH MY SON

arabic text: HAI MERE SAR KI RIDA BHI, TERI TURBAT SE BADI,\nASGHAR E BESHEER JAISI QABR HA ABBAS KI
english translation text: MY HEAD COVERING ALONE IS LONGER THAN YOUR GRAVE. THE GRAVE\nOF ABBAS HOLDS A LIKENESS TO THE GRAVE OF ALI ASGHAR
